_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Tuvalu.

910.name: Early Settlement of Tuvalu
910.description: Polynesian peoples settle the Tuvalu atolls from Samoa and Tonga.

sub_clusters.name: Polynesian Settlement
sub_clusters.description: Settlers from Samoa, Tonga, and possibly Micronesia; atoll adaptation.

920.name: Pre-Contact Tuvaluan Society
920.description: Small atoll communities with Polynesian social structure; oral traditions.

sub_clusters.name: Aliki Chiefly System
sub_clusters.description: Hereditary chiefs (aliki); communal land tenure; fale kaupule governance.

sub_clusters.name: Atoll Subsistence
sub_clusters.description: Coconut, pandanus, pulaka pit cultivation; reef fishing; remarkable adaptation.

930.name: European Contact
930.description: Spanish sighting; whalers; blackbirding devastation; missionaries.

sub_clusters.name: Mendaña Sighting (1568)
sub_clusters.description: Álvaro de Mendaña possibly sights Nui; sporadic European contacts follow.

sub_clusters.name: Blackbirding Devastation
sub_clusters.description: Peruvian slave raids and labour recruiting depopulate several islands.

sub_clusters.name: Samoan LMS Pastors
sub_clusters.description: Samoan-trained LMS pastors convert Tuvalu; reshape social life.

940.name: British Colonial Period
940.description: Ellice Islands Protectorate; part of Gilbert and Ellice Islands Colony.

sub_clusters.name: Ellice Islands Protectorate
sub_clusters.description: British protectorate to prevent other colonial claims; minimal governance.

sub_clusters.name: Gilbert and Ellice Islands Colony
sub_clusters.description: Joined with Micronesian Gilberts; Polynesian Ellice minority.

950.name: World War II in Tuvalu
950.description: US military base on Funafuti; bombing raids; transformative contact.

sub_clusters.name: US Base on Funafuti
sub_clusters.description: Airstrip built; thousands of Marines; Japanese bombing raids.

950.name: Separation and Independence
950.description: Ellice Islands separate from Gilberts; Tuvalu gains independence.

sub_clusters.name: Separation Referendum (1974)
sub_clusters.description: Ellice Islanders vote overwhelmingly to separate from Gilbert Islands.

sub_clusters.name: Tuvalu Independence (1978)
sub_clusters.description: Independence 1 October 1978; Toaripi Lauti first PM.

960.name: .tv Domain Windfall
960.description: Tuvalu's .tv internet domain becomes significant revenue source.

sub_clusters.name: .tv Domain Licensing
sub_clusters.description: Multi-million dollar deals for .tv domain; funds UN membership; major GDP contribution.

960.name: Climate Change Frontline
960.description: Tuvalu as poster child for climate crisis; average elevation 2m; existential threat.

sub_clusters.name: Sea Level Rise Emergency
sub_clusters.description: King tides flood Funafuti; saltwater intrusion; groundwater contamination.

sub_clusters.name: Climate Diplomacy
sub_clusters.description: Copenhagen tears; AOSIS leadership; 'we are not drowning, we are fighting'.

sub_clusters.name: Digital Nation Initiative
sub_clusters.description: Plan to create digital replica of Tuvalu in metaverse to preserve sovereignty.

sub_clusters.name: Australia Falepili Union Treaty
sub_clusters.description: Climate refuge treaty with Australia; residency rights in exchange for security partnership.
